title: Normalized finite dualizing complexes when the reduction is regular
statement:
Let $k$ be a field and $\ell$ a prime invertible in $k$. Let $a:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be the structure morphism of a nonempty separated finite-type $k$-scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism]. Assume that its reduction $X_{\mathrm{red}}$ (the closed subscheme obtained by quotienting the structure sheaf by its nilradical) is regular [def-weil-regular-scheme] and that $|X|$ is irreducible [def-weil-irreducible-components]. Put $d=\dim|X|$, using topological Krull dimension [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. For $n\geq1$ put $\Lambda_n=\mathbf Z/\ell^n\mathbf Z$. On the small etale sites use bounded constructible complexes [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes] and the finite-coefficient exceptional adjoint $a_n^!$ of $Ra_!$ appearing in [lem-per-adic-exceptional-projection]. There are isomorphisms
$$a_n^!(\Lambda_n)_k\cong \Lambda_{n,X}(d)[2d],$$
where $\Lambda_{n,X}(0)$ is the coefficient sheaf and, for $d>0$, $\Lambda_{n,X}(d)=\mu_{\ell^n,X}^{\otimes_{\Lambda_{n,X}}d}$. Here $\mu_{\ell^n,X}$ is the etale sheaf of units $u$ with $u^{\ell^n}=1$, with its $\Lambda_n$-module structure given by exponentiation. These twists are locally free of rank one. The isomorphisms may be chosen compatibly with derived coefficient reduction $\Lambda_{n+1}\to\Lambda_n$: under them the reduction tower of $a_n^!(\Lambda_n)_k[-2d]$ is the ordinary tower of rank-one sheaves $\Lambda_{n,X}(d)$, whose transition on roots of unity is $u\mapsto u^\ell$. The normalization is the relative dimension function $x\mapsto\operatorname{trdeg}_k\kappa(x)$, with coefficient unit at $\operatorname{Spec}k$. No perfectness or separable-generation hypothesis on $k$ or $X/k$ is imposed.
